taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-02 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 364.5 | 0.81 | 0.81
2 | 257.8 | 2.53 | 3.34
3 | 745.5 | 12.65 | 15.99
4 | 1146.1 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as HA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-02
Curve type: HA-type
Aquifer depth: 0.81 m – 3.34 m
Recommendation: The low-resistivity second layer (257.8 ohm-m) between 0.81 m and 3.34 m depth is interpreted as the main water-bearing zone; design the well screen to target this interval. Given its limited thickness, confirm yield with a pumping test, as the underlying high-resistivity layers (745.5 and 1146.1 ohm-m) likely represent compact or unsaturated formations unsuitable for further water extraction.
